story.title: Girls Planting Tree
paragraphs_en: On Sunday, Nunu was planting trees with the farmers who looked after the garden. "Uncle, can you help me plant a tree?" asked Nunu "With a pleasure, dear "said uncle.
Nunu was happy and she watered the tree every morning so tree grew well.
Meanwhile, Nami, Nunu's sister was not as diligent as Nunu... "Mom, where is nunu?" asked Nami. "Nunu is watering and taking care of tree," said mommy.
Then, following Nunu, Nami planted a tree. Actually she did not like planting but she wanted to look diligent, just like Nunu.
Nami forgot to water her tree so the tree was dry.
Nunu's tree looked green and beautiful, Nunu was very happy. “yeay! I am happy, I am happy!”
However, Nami's tree did not grow because it was dry.
Nunu invited Nami to play under the tree with her and Nami realized that she could not only follow what her sister did but also should love it and take care of it.

Nami hỏi: "Mẹ ơi, Nunu đâu rồi ạ?"

sentences.text_en: Then, following Nunu, Nami planted a tree.
sentences.text_vi: Sau đó, làm theo Nunu, Nami cũng trồng một cái cây.

sentences.text_vi: Thật ra cô bé không thích trồng cây, nhưng cô bé muốn trông có vẻ chăm chỉ, giống như Nunu.

sentences.text_en: Nami forgot to water her tree so the tree was dry.
sentences.text_vi: Nami quên mất tưới nước cho cây của mình nên cái cây bị khô héo.

sentences.text_en: Nunu's tree looked green and beautiful, Nunu was very happy.
sentences.text_vi: Cây của Nunu trông xanh tươi và đẹp đẽ, Nunu rất vui.

sentences.text_en: “yeay! I am happy, I am happy!”
sentences.text_vi: Nunu reo lên: "Cháu vui quá, cháu vui quá!"

sentences.text_en: However, Nami's tree did not grow because it was dry.
sentences.text_vi: Tuy nhiên, cây của Nami lại không lớn lên vì nó đã bị khô héo.

sentences.text_en: Nunu invited Nami to play under the tree with her and Nami realized that she could not only follow what her sister did but also should love it and take care of it.
sentences.text_vi: Nunu mời Nami đến chơi dưới gốc cây cùng mình và Nami nhận ra rằng cô bé không chỉ nên làm theo những gì chị mình làm mà còn phải yêu thương và chăm sóc nó nữa.
